principle: BodyStyleProfile is visual/sculptural grammar, not mechanical architecture. A profile may be used across compatible architectures only through an explicit style-transfer operation.

traits.sculpt_vs_print: major anatomy/silhouette carried by mould; color/pattern carries clothing/detail
traits.head_relation: integrated in early architecture, separate giant head in later architecture

traits.anatomy: broad upper body while preserving standard head and lower body
traits.joints: specialized enlarged arms attached to oversized torso
traits.sculpt_vs_print: upper-body bulk is moulded; normal minifigure lower-body style remains

traits.anatomy: broad/tall integrated body with standard head ecosystem
traits.sculpt_vs_print: body silhouette carries scale; face remains standard-head visual grammar

traits.anatomy: strongly anatomical muscular torso and limbs

traits.proportions: approximately 7 cm class in documented examples; larger hands/feet and longer limbs than standard
traits.sculpt_vs_print: muscle groups and much costume structure carried in 3D relief; printed details supplement sculpt
